sources.snippet: Previous releases: N1.6 | N1.5 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7 is an open vision-language-action (VLA) model for generalized humanoid robot skills. This cross-embodiment model takes multimodal input, including language and images, to perform manipulation tasks in diverse environments.
